build_symmetric_monomer_program: build a symmetric monomer protein design program with a specified number of protomers using shared sequence segments
create_protomer_nodes: create ProgramNode instances for each protomer sharing a single FixedLengthSequenceSegment of 50 residues
configure_energy_optimization: configure energy function terms including MaximizePTM, MaximizePLDDT, SymmetryRing, and MinimizeSurfaceHydrophobics for protein design
run_symmetric_monomer_design: run the symmetric_monomer function with a given number of protomers to generate a ProgramNode for ring-symmetric protein design
review_symmetry_ring_program: review the symmetric_monomer ProgramNode structure with shared sequences and ring symmetry constraints across multiple protomers
